## Lab 2 - web app dashboard
Five charts: CPU, memory, requests, P95 latency, replicas.

content.query:
let pods = KubePodInventory | where Namespace == "default" and Name startswith "web-" | summarize by PodUid, PodName = Name;
Perf | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) and ObjectName == "K8SContainer" and CounterName == "cpuUsageNanoCores"
| extend parts = split(InstanceName, "/") | extend PodUid = tostring(parts[array_length(parts) - 2]) | join kind=inner pods on PodUid
| summarize CPU_pct_of_limit = avg(CounterValue) / 2000000 by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), PodName | render timechart
content.title: CPU per pod (% of 200m limit)

content.query:
let pods = KubePodInventory | where Namespace == "default" and Name startswith "web-" | summarize by PodUid, PodName = Name;
Perf | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) and ObjectName == "K8SContainer" and CounterName == "memoryWorkingSetBytes"
| extend parts = split(InstanceName, "/") | extend PodUid = tostring(parts[array_length(parts) - 2]) | join kind=inner pods on PodUid
| summarize Memory_MiB = avg(CounterValue) / 1048576 by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), PodName | render timechart
content.title: Memory per pod (MiB)

content.query: AppRequests | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | summarize Requests = sum(ItemCount) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m) | render columnchart
content.title: HTTP requests per minute

content.query: AppRequests | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | summarize P95_ms = percentile(DurationMs, 95) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m) | render timechart
content.title: P95 latency (ms)

content.query: KubePodInventory | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) and Namespace == "default" and Name startswith "web-" and PodStatus == "Running" | summarize Replicas = dcount(PodUid) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m) | render timechart
content.title: Active web replicas
